documents.title: Main Contract — access and change control
documents.text:
Project: Harbour View Medical Centre.
Contract extract, clause 4.2: the employer shall provide the east service yard by 03 October 2026.
Clause 13.1: variations require written instruction by the employer's representative before valuation.
Clause 20.3: a notice of delay is due within 14 calendar days after the event becomes known.
This extract is a training summary and is not a complete contract.

documents.title: Fire stopping specification — section 07 84 00
documents.text:
All service penetrations through rated walls require a tested fire-stop system.
The installed system rating must equal or exceed the fire-resistance rating of the wall assembly.
Installation records and inspection approval are required before concealment.
Approved product data must be linked to the relevant inspection record.

documents.title: RFI-017 — chilled-water riser clearance
documents.text:
RFI: RFI-017.
Question: Confirm the required clearance at the level 4 chilled-water riser crossing.
Submitted by: MEP contractor on 12 October 2026.
Requested response date: 21 October 2026.
Status on 30 October 2026: no response recorded; the RFI remains open.
The meeting record links this clarification to level 4 coordination.

signals.title: RFI-017 remains unanswered after its requested response date
signals.fact: RFI-017 is recorded as open with no response as of 30 October 2026; its requested response date was 21 October 2026.
signals.inference: The unresolved clearance may constrain level 4 coordination; the record does not quantify a schedule impact.
signals.recommendation: Confirm the responsible reviewer and response date, then assess any affected work sequence.

documents.text:

signals.title: Meeting action A-14 is past due without completion evidence

documents.title: Inspection IR-208 — level 3 fire stopping
documents.text:
Inspection: IR-208, level 3 west riser, completed 28 October 2026.
Observation: one service penetration has no approved system label visible at inspection.
Status: nonconformance NCR-008 opened; corrective evidence and reinspection are not recorded as of 30 October 2026.
Specification 07 84 00 requires accepted product evidence and inspection approval before concealment.
No statement is made here that the wall assembly has failed; the open item concerns missing verification evidence.

signals.title: NCR-008 is open for missing fire-stop verification evidence
signals.fact: IR-208 records NCR-008 as open; corrective evidence and reinspection are not recorded as of 30 October 2026.
signals.inference: Concealment before verified closeout could create rework or compliance exposure; the report does not establish an installed system failure.
signals.recommendation: Keep the affected penetration visible until the responsible inspector confirms corrective evidence and reinspection status.

documents.title: Weekly progress report — week ending 28 October
documents.text:
Progress report issued 28 October 2026.

Commissioning is shown in the baseline for 15 November 2026.
The report flags a possible commissioning risk if the listed inputs remain unresolved; it does not issue a revised forecast date.

signals.title: Commissioning has a recorded dependency risk, but no revised forecast
signals.fact: The progress report lists commissioning on the baseline for 15 November and flags possible risk if RFI-017 and Submittal-044 remain unresolved; no revised forecast is recorded.
signals.inference: If the inputs remain open, commissioning readiness could be affected; the evidence does not establish that the milestone will slip.
signals.recommendation: Ask planning and discipline leads to validate the remaining logic, float, and recovery options before updating the forecast.

documents.title: Contractor notice — east yard access delay
documents.text:
Contractor letter dated 18 October 2026.
The contractor states that east service yard access was not available until 10 October 2026.
The letter requests time and cost review and refers to a delay notice.
This letter records the contractor's position only; it is not an agreed determination.
The contract extract states an access date of 03 October 2026 and a 14-calendar-day notice period.

signals.title: Access dates differ between the contractor letter and access log
signals.fact: The contractor letter says access was unavailable until 10 October; the access log records access granted on 03 October.
signals.inference: The competing records leave the alleged delay period unresolved; entitlement and causation cannot be determined from this dataset.
signals.recommendation: Reconcile the dated access records, notices, and contemporaneous site logs before any commercial or schedule determination.
